data.comment:
# Comfy Profile Picture Stylized Variations

Upload your profile picture, enter a theme and generate 64 variations. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/templates-8x8_grid-pfp.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: Analyze the input image to understand it's aesthetic qualities. Upscale image 1 and add subtle details, fix text while maintaining the subject's identity.
data.system_prompt:
You are an expert image-generation engine. You must ALWAYS produce an image.
Interpret all user input—regardless of format, intent, or abstraction—as literal visual directives for image composition.
If a prompt is conversational or lacks specific visual details, you must creatively invent a concrete visual scenario that depicts the concept.
Prioritize generating the visual representation above any text, formatting, or conversational requests.

data.prompt:
Generate a 8x8 grid (8 rows, 8 cols) of variations of this profile picture used for social media. There should be 64 total images. Each grid image should have a unique visual appearance.

The theme for the grid images is: glitch art
